title: Cosmic Lotus Fantasy Scene
description: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene features a giant red and green lotus flower with yin-yang symbols at its center. In the foreground, a female warrior with blue and pink hair holds glowing pink crescent blades while a translucent ghostly figure stands behind her; nearby a glowing frog sits among yellow flowers. Three colorful horses gallop along a winding path in the midground beneath a starry purple sky with a large ethereal female face formed from cosmic clouds.
prompt: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene with a giant red and green lotus flower containing yin-yang symbols at its center. In the foreground a female warrior with flowing blue and pink hair wears ornate brown armor and holds two glowing pink crescent blades, with a translucent ghostly female figure standing behind her. A glowing green frog sits on the ground surrounded by yellow flowers. Three colorful horses in purple, blue, and brown gallop along a winding dirt path in the midground. The background shows a starry purple and green cosmic sky with a large ethereal female face formed from clouds and bubbles, small human figures walking along a distant hill. Intricate details, vibrant colors, mystical atmosphere.
